title: Euclidean UInt64 GCD loop
summary: Supplies the invariant and arithmetic facts for a UInt64 Euclidean remainder loop after checked scalar-loop execution has exposed its transitions.
premises: Two UInt64 accumulators implementing Euclidean remainder steps
A checked body and condition transition
A nonzero divisor in the continuing branch
result: A GCD-preserving loop invariant and strict divisor measure for the zero and nonzero Euclidean branches.
